contract: POST /api/session/:id/sync. Sync only an owned/admin open session: add listened time, persist current position/duration and correct book/episode progress, reject missing/negative data and emit owner progress after success.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
force is not applicable: session sync has no force mode; every sync applies its payload.

invariants.contract: POST /api/session/:id/sync. Sync only an owned/admin open session: add listened time, persist current position/duration and correct book/episode progress, reject missing/negative data and emit owner progress after success.
exceptions: Assertion leads only; missing normal/error/edge and state-transition proof must be supplied by the owning packet.

invariants.contract: A sync within the library's markAsFinishedTimeRemaining of the end marks the progress finished with a finish time and ratio 1, and a later sync far from the end clears it. With markAsFinishedPercentComplete set on the library the percentage rule replaces the time-remaining rule in both directions.
Sync is refused with 401 unauthenticated, 404 for an unknown or closed session (before the owner check), 403 for another non-admin user, and changes neither progress, session nor events.
When the session's library item has been deleted, sync answers 500 and changes neither the session nor any progress, and emits no progress event.
